project_name: Base Year Configuration - Hierarchical Structure & Flexible Data Entry Levels

typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.level_scope: text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200

tree_indentation.level_1_scope: pl-2 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50
tree_indentation.level_2_category: pl-8 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950
tree_indentation.level_3_subcategory: pl-16 py-2 border-b border-slate-50 dark:border-slate-900 bg-slate-50/30 dark:bg-slate-900/20

new_or_enhanced_subcomponents.name: BaseYearDataEntryLevelSelector
new_or_enhanced_subcomponents.description: Explicit Admin Control selector allowing choice between Scope, Category, and Subcategory level entry with helper descriptions and impact indicators.

new_or_enhanced_subcomponents.name: BaseYearHierarchyTree
new_or_enhanced_subcomponents.description: Collapsible tree renderer displaying Scope -> Category -> Subcategory hierarchy with level-aware input fields, expand/collapse toggles, and data integrity warnings.

new_or_enhanced_subcomponents.name: BaseYearIntegrityBanner
new_or_enhanced_subcomponents.description: Visual indicator banner explaining current entry level rules and preventing accidental double-counting or level conflict.

level_rules.scope_level: Admin inputs total tCO2e directly at Scope 1, Scope 2, or Scope 3. Subcategories & categories are disabled/hidden for data entry to prevent double counting.
level_rules.category_level: Admin inputs tCO2e at Scope 1 -> Stationary Combustion, Scope 1 -> Mobile Combustion, etc. Subcategories are disabled for data entry.
level_rules.subcategory_level: Admin inputs tCO2e at Scope 1 -> Stationary Combustion -> Diesel, Petrol, etc. Full granular entry.

data_integrity_and_validation.no_auto_aggregation_rule: Do not automatically sum or derive parent-level values from child-level values unless explicitly configured. Distinguish entered values vs lower-level entries clearly.
data_integrity_and_validation.double_counting_prevention: System validates that entries exist exclusively at the selected configuration level. Any attempt to enter data at conflicting levels for the same base year is blocked with user-friendly validation messages.

motion_and_interactions.collapsible_animation: Smooth max-height / opacity transition using Framer Motion or Shadcn Collapsible component

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large headers and badges
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Tree nodes are focusable and expandable via Enter/Space bar keys
accessibility.aria_labels: All tree nodes, inputs, and toggles include descriptive aria-expanded, aria-level, aria-label, and data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace the current single-line presentation (Scope + Category + Subcategory) with a rich hierarchical tree component.
Implement the Data Entry Level Selector (Scope, Category, Subcategory) giving Admin explicit control over entry granularity.
Ensure input fields render at the chosen level while preserving existing subcategory functionality when selected.
Enforce data integrity: prevent double-counting between parent and child levels for the same base year.
Maintain backward compatibility with backend endpoints (`/api/base-year-emissions`), ensuring `emissions_data` payload and DB schemas remain fully functional.
Adhere to clean, modern UI styling with clear level badges, indentation, and responsive design.
Include all required `data-testid` attributes across all interactive and informational UI components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as full-screen gradients. Keep clean high-contrast surfaces.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use structured grids and hierarchy.
Add transition for hover/active/focus states on buttons and interactive elements.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons. Use Lucide icons (e.g. ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Layers, ShieldCheck, Info).
Container with borders MUST have internal padding (p-4 to p-8) to prevent text collision.
